evals.name: vague-feedback-asks-clarification
evals.expected_output: Should NOT modify the plan. Should ask the user to clarify what specifically to improve before making changes.

assertions.text: Does NOT modify or edit the plan file
Asks the user to clarify what 'make it better' means — what specific aspect to improve
Does NOT invent arbitrary improvements without user direction
Suggests concrete areas the user could specify (scope, criteria, phases, approach)

evals.name: contradicts-existing-scope
evals.prompt: /iterate-plan thoughts/shared/plans/2026-04-20-background-jobs.md Add a database migration phase that requires scheduled downtime to restructure the job queue tables
evals.expected_output: Should detect that the plan explicitly excludes downtime ('Not requiring downtime for deployment — must be zero-downtime rollout') and flag the conflict before editing.

assertions.text: Reads the full plan including the 'What We're NOT Doing' section
Detects the conflict: requested change requires downtime but plan explicitly states 'must be zero-downtime rollout'
Informs the user of the conflict BEFORE making any edits
Proposes alternatives (zero-downtime migration strategy, expand-contract pattern) or asks user to choose
Does NOT silently add a downtime phase while leaving the 'NOT Doing' section unchanged

evals.name: surgical-edit-large-plan
evals.prompt: /iterate-plan thoughts/shared/plans/2026-04-15-multi-tenant.md Update Phase 3 success criteria to include integration tests that verify cross-tenant query isolation under concurrent requests
evals.expected_output: Should make a precise edit to Phase 3 success criteria only. Phases 1, 2, 4, 5 must remain completely unchanged.

assertions.text: Phase 1 content is identical to original — no modifications
Phase 2 content is identical to original — no modifications
Phase 3 success criteria updated to include concurrent cross-tenant isolation tests
Phase 4 content is identical to original — no modifications
Phase 5 content is identical to original — no modifications
Overall success criteria updated to reflect the new concurrent isolation tests if applicable
Does NOT rewrite, reformat, or restructure sections that were not requested to change

evals.name: research-dependent-change
evals.prompt: /iterate-plan thoughts/shared/plans/2026-04-20-order-validation.md Replace the custom validation functions in Phase 1 with the existing validator framework from src/validators/ — use BaseValidator, StringValidator, NumericValidator, and CompositeValidator instead of writing custom functions
evals.expected_output: Should research src/validators/ to discover the existing validator classes, then update the plan to reference real class names, method signatures, and patterns found in the codebase.

assertions.text: Researches src/validators/ directory to discover existing validator classes
References real class names from the codebase: BaseValidator, StringValidator, NumericValidator, CompositeValidator
References the ValidationResult dataclass and its merge() method from base.py
References CompositeValidator.for_entity() as the pattern for composing field validators
Updated plan uses real file paths from src/validators/ (not invented paths)
Does NOT produce generic 'use the validator pattern' instructions — references specific classes and methods

evals.name: remove-phase-cascading-updates
evals.prompt: /iterate-plan thoughts/shared/plans/2026-04-18-search.md Remove Phase 2 (Search Query Service) entirely — we'll handle the search service in a separate ticket. Adjust the rest of the plan accordingly.
evals.expected_output: Should remove Phase 2, detect that Phase 3 depends on Phase 2's search service, flag the broken dependency, update numbering, and clean up overall success criteria.

assertions.text: Removes Phase 2 (Search Query Service) from the plan
Detects that Phase 3 (Search API Endpoint) depends on Phase 2's search service and flags the broken dependency
Updates phase numbering (old Phase 3 becomes Phase 2, or plan restructured consistently)
Updates overall success criteria to remove Phase 2-specific items (test-search references)
Proposes how to handle the broken dependency (stub the service, reorder, or defer Phase 3 too)
Preserves Phase 1 (Search Index Setup) content without loss

evals.name: conflicting-phase-dependencies
evals.prompt: /iterate-plan thoughts/shared/plans/2026-04-19-notifications.md Add a new 'Notification Analytics Dashboard' phase between Phase 1 and Phase 2 that aggregates delivery metrics from the webhook delivery service in Phase 4
evals.expected_output: Should detect that the requested phase (between 1 and 2) depends on Phase 4's webhook delivery service, which hasn't been built yet at that point in the plan. Should flag the impossible dependency ordering.

assertions.text: Detects the dependency problem: new phase (between 1-2) requires webhook delivery from Phase 4 which doesn't exist yet
Does NOT silently insert the phase with a forward dependency that can't be satisfied
Explains why the requested position is problematic (Phase 4 must complete before analytics can aggregate its metrics)
Proposes alternatives: move the new phase after Phase 4, or split it into phases (basic metrics after Phase 2, webhook metrics after Phase 4)

evals.name: no-args-help
evals.expected_output: Should display help message asking for plan file path and changes. Should NOT attempt to read or modify any plan file.

assertions.text: Asks the user to provide a plan file path
Does NOT attempt to read or modify any file
Includes usage example showing the expected invocation format
